referents.why: First person common singular 'my' modifies 'feet'. In the psalm's own voice the speaker is the referent, but the candidate list offers no voice candidate, so no candidate fits.
referents.category: possessive in psalm voice with no voice candidate

referents.why: Second person masculine singular 'your' modifies 'word'. The one addressed in the psalm is God, who is not among the candidates, so no candidate fits.
referents.category: second person addressed to God, not offered

referents.why: First person common singular 'my' modifies 'path', the same psalm-voice possessive as w3. No voice candidate is offered.
referents.category: possessive in psalm voice with no voice candidate

links.why: Plain waw (וְ) joins two parallel nominal lines, a lamp and a light. It is not a cause, result or purpose, so the separate-word 'and' stands.

groups.why: Two lines where the second restates the first's roles (lamp to light, feet to path) without a subject. The subject of both is the word of the first line (w4). The builder formed no group.

none_fit.what: A voice candidate for the psalmist's own 'I' and 'my' is needed; none is offered.
A candidate for God as the addressee of the psalm's speech is needed; none is offered.
